prompt: Here's a NestJS server that renders HTML pages and locks them down with a CSP nonce. Two weeks ago the team shipped the policy in `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only` mode — violations flowed to a `/csp-report` endpoint but nothing was blocked, and the stream looked quiet enough that it was treated as compatible. Yesterday they flipped it to enforce mode (`Content-Security-Policy`) and every page broke instantly: the browser refuses every inline `<script>` tag, even though each one clearly carries a nonce attribute. Walk through the wiring below, find the root cause, and explain why report-only hid it for two weeks — then tell me how you'd fix it and verify it before the next report-only-to-enforce graduation.
